name: Smart Click Sounds
description: Realistic click sounds that react to how you click: lighter spam, matched releases, no repeats.

menu-keybind.name: Open this menu
menu-keybind.description: Key that opens Smart Click Sounds' settings from anywhere in the game.

spam.name: Spam / fast clicks
spam.description: How much lighter fast clicks sound. Clicks 150 ms+ apart are always full strength.

variation.name: Variation
variation.description: How different each variation is: small pitch, tone, hit and ring changes to the recorded clicks.

sounds.name: Sounds
sounds.description: Which recorded clicks to use. 'Both' mixes the reference clicks with the ones you recorded (they sound alike after Clean tone).

pitch.name: Pitch (semitones)
pitch.description: Higher or lower clicks. 0 = as recorded.

variations.name: Click variations
variations.description: How many different click variations to make from the recorded clicks. Each one is used once before any repeats.

clean-tone.name: Clean tone
clean-tone.description: Removes the desk 'boom' so clicks sound crisp instead of clunky.

room-tone.name: Room tone
room-tone.description: Adds the faint background hiss of a real room under the clicks while you're in a level, like a real mic recording (never total silence between clicks).

pack-folder.name: Click pack folder
pack-folder.description: Optional: any clickpack folder (with player1\\clicks, or clicks + releases folders). When set, it's used instead of the Sounds setting.
